darkGreen.usedFor: The signature dark green. Fills the hero, the page header bands, and the 'Let's talk' sections — and is also the color of nearly every heading and piece of dark text on the site. Changing this changes the most.

darkGreenLight.usedFor: A softer green used in exactly two places: the italic words in the homepage headline ('span generations.'), and the large 01/02/03/04 step numbers in the 'How I work' section.

photoBackdrop.usedFor: Sits behind every photo on the site. Visible for a moment while a photo loads, and permanently anywhere a photo is missing. Keep this close to darkGreen.

cream.usedFor: The off-white page background and the top navigation bar. Also the color of text and headings that sit on top of the dark green sections.

panelCream.usedFor: A slightly deeper cream that lifts inset panels off the page background — the off-market box, the 'Recently closed' band, the credentials strip on the About page, and the alternating market rows.

panelCreamDark.usedFor: Only used when hovering the expand button on an active property card.

gold.usedFor: The accent. All the small uppercase labels above section headings, the short divider rules beneath them, the quote marks on pull-quotes, and the underline on whichever nav link you're currently on.

bodyText.usedFor: Ordinary paragraph text sitting on cream backgrounds. A muted green-grey rather than plain grey.

footerGreen.usedFor: The footer background only. Deliberately a shade darker than darkGreen so the footer reads as separate from the section above it.

comingSoonBackground.usedFor: Background of the 'Coming Soon' holding page — the page visitors see while "enabled" is false in settings.json. Not visible once the site is live.

errorRed.usedFor: The warning message on the contact form when a message fails to send. The only non-green/cream/gold color on the site.
